name: Crossroads Challengers 2027
overview: Crossroads Challengers 2027 is the Tier 2 international League of Legends event of the Crossroads series. Organized by Riot Games, it takes place in Amsterdam, Netherlands, from April 20 to May 2, 2027, with a total prize pool of USD 300,000. Sixteen teams qualify through regional allocation: three each from the LCK, LPL, LEC and LCS, and two each from the LCP and CBLOL. Academy Blue and White have no automatic qualification.
format: LCK 3; LPL 3; LEC 3; LCS 3; LCP 2; CBLOL 2.
